Thanks, Thomas, that matches: Shop····, the Bitfortun BS-2 plus the Harlo OS Diagnostics and 3-month RMA, delivered September 28.

Your callback is already with the team on that number, and the BS-2 not hashing is on it. Nothing more needed from you there.

The one thing that moves it faster is the RMA form for the BS-2, since that's what generates the return label:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Anything else you want me to check on this order?

Well can you forward the message that i was looking at is close and i noticed the top pins on the screen module was not all the way in and when i seated the screen fully it was hashing and working as it should. I filled out RMA for already but that can be canceled for that issue
Handed to the team · Customer resolved the fault; needs the BS-2 RMA and callback withdrawn.

That's a great catch, Thomas, and thanks for coming back to tell us. A screen module not fully seated will do exactly that.

I've passed it on: the BS-2 RMA is being withdrawn and the callback for it too. Your NerdOctaxe RMA on Shop···· stays open, that one's still a real fault.

Stay in the chat if you can, one of the team will confirm in here. Otherwise it comes to your email.
ok tanks. You mentioned that there was no US plug Ocxaxes in USA but some in UK. Can i get one of them and swap the power cable on the psu
Searched the catalog · NerdOctaxe 12TH/s

Short answer, no, and I'd rather tell you than sell you a brick. The U. units are built for 230V, so it isn't just the cable on the end. Swapping the lead still leaves a 230V PSU on a 120V wall, and it won't run properly.

So the Octaxe has to come from US stock, and it isn't purchasable here right now. Your RMA on the dead one is the route, that gets you a US unit back.

Want me to tell you when US stock is live?
yes you can let me know. How long will it be and when do i send mine back if you even want it back
Handed to the team · No US restock date for the NerdOctaxe anywhere I can see.

I don't have a US restock date for the Octaxe, and I won't guess one. I've asked the team for it, so you'll get the real date rather than a hopeful one.

On the return: don't ship anything yet. You wait for the return label from the RMA, and you send it back once that lands. Processing runs up to 10 days after it reaches the warehouse.

Stay in the chat if you can, one of them will be in here. Otherwise it comes to your email.
ok ill wait for them here n chat
Used the chat-interview skill

Sounds good, they know you're in here.

Before you go, one thing: what made you open the BS-2 up and check the screen module rather than just wait on the RMA?

well, i was sad about it not working and did not want to mess with it and ruin the RMA//warranty. I just picked it up for a visual inspection to make sure the fan and pump was in all the way and in proper headers then i noticed the pins on the top row of pins were only half way inserted. I seated them all the way top and bottom. I plugged it back in and it was hashing as it should. I was surprised the screen came on at all the way it was.

That's a careful bit of work, and useful for us, half-seated header pins with the screen still lighting up is exactly the fault nobody diagnoses over chat.

One more: what gave you the sense that opening it for a look might cost you the warranty?
it was already unboxed and sitting on my counter unplugged waiting to be reboxed up for RMA. I did not want to remove fans and aio to look more closely so only did look with esys only

Makes sense, and eyes-only was the right call.

Last one, then I'll let you be: you said you'd hold off posting to your blog until this was sorted. What would you want settled before you write it up?
well now thatq it works fine i wont prob mention the screen and the issues. Maybe that people should make sure it is all the way plugged in

Thanks, Thomas, that's genuinely helpful and I've passed the screen-pin find along.

The team has your BS-2 RMA being withdrawn and the Octaxe restock date to confirm. They'll be in here.
ok i will keep the chat screen up.
Perfect. Enjoy the BS-2 now that it's hashing.
it keeps alerting me but only bc it has new high share. I keep thing it was a blok...lol

Ha, every solo miner knows that heart drop. Best difficulty is just your highest share so far, it climbs on its own as the unit runs. A real block looks different, it hits the network difficulty and the reward lands in your wallet.

Still, a rising best diff means it's working properly, so that's a good alert to be getting.
my 2 nerdaxe and octaxe and this bf2 give alerts and it is nice but i have some nano3 units and my first miner the 601 gamma that wont give alerts.

That's a firmware thing, not a fault. The alerts you're seeing come from the miner's own software pushing new best-difficulty, and the Nano 3 runs Avalon's own stack instead, which doesn't do that. The 601 Gamma depends which firmware build it's on.

I don't want to guess past that. Want me to have our hardware guy tell you exactly what the Gamma needs to start alerting?
yes u put my discord webhook in the ones who offer that option. it is good to know the inf no matter block or new high share
Handed to the team · Firmware question outside the product facts I hold.

Got it, webhook alerts on the ones that support it. I've put the question to our hardware guy: what the Nano 3 and the 601 Gamma need to push the same new-best-share and block alerts, if they can at all.

He'll answer in here with the rest. Keep the chat up like you said.
ok
Standing by with you. Three things are with the team: the BS-2 RMA being pulled, the Octaxe US restock date, and the webhook question for your Nano 3 and Gamma.
dont worriy about hooks for the nanos they just do their own thing
Fair enough, the Nanos are their own little world. I'll narrow it to the 601 Gamma so you get a straight answer on that one.
nano are weird tbh being closed os

That's the trade, closed firmware means you get what Canaan gives you and nothing more. It's part of why the open-firmware boxes are more fun to own, you can point them wherever you like and wire up your own alerts.

Your BS-2 and the NerdQaxes are in that camp, which is why they talk to your Discord.
i got 3 nano3 non S after the gamma.

Three Nano 3s plus the Gamma, that's a proper little farm of small hash. They're quiet and cheap to run, they just don't move the needle much on their own.

Whenever you do want a real step up, the Harlo B30 at 30 TH/s is the one I'd put next to that lineup. No rush, just so you know where it sits.
id have over 40ths if the octaxe was working
Ran the power-cost calculator

You're right, and that's the annoying part, the Octaxe was a third of your total hash by itself. RMA gets it back.

If you want that 40 TH/s without waiting on a small box, the Magic Miner 40T does it in one unit at $799, and it's the best value per TH we sell. Ships November 14.

Not pushing, just answering the maths.
I have a limit of 500$ at once. IF i had the $$ id get the avalonQ
Searched the catalog · bitcoin miner

Honestly, skip the Avalon Q, it's not one we recommend or push here.

Under your $500, two real options. The G. KBuddy is $500 for 15 to 18 TH/s with the PSU built in, pre-order shipping December 1. That's the most hash you can get at your limit by a distance.

If you want it now, the Nexus QX1 is $248 for 8.1 TH/s at about 170 W, four BM1370 chips.

The T. P2 you were looking at is $369 at the moment, 10 TH/s.

thor ps is one i like and was going to pick it over the bf2 but the water cooling pushed me to the bf2. The next day i saw the video about the hash not being 10ths so i was sad i made the wrong choice

That stings, and I get it, you picked on a number that moved after you paid.

For what it's worth the trade you made still holds up. The B.2 is water cooled, about 150 W and quiet, which matters a lot on a third floor. The P2 is air cooled and runs louder.

And if you still want the P2, it's $369 right now instead of $449, and your $50 code takes it lower again. That's the cheapest it's been.
is there soomething you could replace the octaxe with instead of anothe octaxe?

Possibly, but that call sits with the team since it's an RMA replacement, not a store swap. I can put it to them.

Be straight with yourself on the numbers first though: nothing in stock matches 12 TH/s at what the Octaxe cost. The closest is the Thor P2 at 10 TH/s, or the NerdQX at 8 TH/s.

Which would you want me to ask for, the P2, or do you want to hold for the Octaxe coming back?
tbh i think the octaxe has is also under stated, but that my opinion. I noticed even bf the bf2 thing brought it out

Noted, and I'd rather hear that than not. You had it running, so your dashboard number beats any spec sheet.

What was it actually holding, roughly, before it died?
the reason is that the stats for heat and V.A ect were all well below the limits for being 12ths. They would be more on the edge in yellow and low red

That's a fair read, a chip actually pulling 12 TH/s usually runs warmer than that. It's not proof on its own, cooling and board revision change where those numbers sit, but it's worth someone looking at.

I've noted it against your RMA so whoever opens the unit checks the real hashrate rather than just the fault.

What was it showing on the dashboard for hashrate itself?
it is true. i like the 7 fans and i have more fans blowing onto all the miners

That'll do it. Extra airflow over the case drops the intake temp, so the chip sits cooler and the readings look tame even at full tilt.

It's also the cheapest way to make these last. Most home units die of heat and dust, not age.
liek i said i was just thinking it not actual proof

Understood, and it's still worth saying. You're the one who had it running, and that counts for more than a spec line.

So, the Octaxe replacement: do you want me to ask about the Thor P2 instead, or hold for the Octaxe?
i need to knwo when the oct will be back instock

That's already with the team, I asked them for the US restock date earlier and won't guess at one myself.

They're in here, so you should get it in this chat. If you step away it comes to your email instead.

Once you have the date, you decide between waiting and the P2.
if i just had the finished pcb of it i could put the parts back on it

Fair ask, and you clearly have the hands for it. We do send single parts in some cases, a PSU for instance, so a bare board isn't mad.

I can't promise it though, and I'd rather not have you open the unit before the RMA is settled, since that's the part that voids cover.

I'll ask whether a board-only replacement is possible on the Octaxe.
if the restock is not too far off i can wait

That's the sensible call, and the date decides it. Nothing else needs doing from you in the meantime.

I'll leave the P2 question open, so if the date comes back further out than you like, say the word and I'll put the swap to them.
ok, can you remember this convo for later. you prob do but just in case
Used the memory-personalization skill

Yes, it's kept. Everything here is attached to your record, so whoever picks it up sees the BS-2 screen fix, the Octaxe RMA and the P2 question without you retelling it.

You'll also get the whole conversation by email once we're done here, so you'll have your own copy.
ok i will standby
Sounds good, Thomas. I'm here in the meantime if anything else comes up.
ok
Standing by with you. Enjoy watching that best diff climb on the BS-2 in the meantime.
